name: tinycast-fuzzy-file-search
title: Fuzzy File Search (TinyCast)
description: Fuzzy-search files by full path. TinyCast-compatible fork of the Raycast Fuzzy File Search extension.
author: erykksc

commands.name: search-for-files
commands.title: Search Files
commands.description: Fuzzy-find files and folders by path using Homebrew fd for indexing and fzf for filtering.

preferences.name: includeDirectories
preferences.title: Include Directories
preferences.label: Search for both directories and files
preferences.description: If enabled, the search results will include files and directories. If disabled, the search will only look for files.

preferences.name: includeHidden
preferences.title: Include Hidden
preferences.label: Include hidden files and directories
preferences.description: If enabled, the results will include hidden files and directories.

preferences.name: followSymlinks
preferences.title: Follow Symbolic Links
preferences.label: Traverse symbolic links
preferences.description: The search will descend into symlinked directories.

preferences.name: ignoreSpacesInSearch
preferences.title: Ignore Spaces in Search
preferences.label: Treat spaces as empty characters
preferences.description: If enabled, spaces in the search query are removed before matching. If disabled, each space-separated word is matched separately (fzf extended search).

preferences.name: customSearchDirs
preferences.title: Custom Search Directories
preferences.description: The list of directories to start in. The search will run in all of those directories. Separate each directory with a whitespace ' '
